text.arabic_uthmani: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ

words.gloss_range: coordinating alternative particle that carries the prior ascent-definition forward and introduces a parallel nominal deed
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) opens the ayah in mid-definition, so the reader carries the prior freeing deed from 90:13 into the next alternative. The particle links another nominal deed, {{ar:إِطْعَٰمٌۭ}} ({{tr:iṭʿāmun}}), to the same ascent-frame rather than starting a detached sentence. Its alternative force is classificatory, not exclusionary: freeing and feeding become distinct bodily forms of the same moral climb. Because the particle comes before the famine-time phrase, the deed is named first and then made costly by its setting.

topics.headline: dependent continuation across the ayah boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by carrying the previous answer forward, not by opening a new independent sentence.
topics.reason: The aligned particle is a coordinating conjunction, and the local clause evidence keeps the ayah inside the nominal answer sequence begun at 90:13.

topics.headline: parallel nominal deed rather than finite-clause shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees feeding as grammatically parallel to the prior compressed deed, so the ascent is defined by concrete deed-categories.
topics.reason: The following word is an indefinite nominative verbal noun, so the particle coordinates predicate-like nominal action rather than introducing a finite narrative clause.

topics.headline: alternative of kinds, not exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alternatives classify different forms of ascent instead of making one bodily rescue cancel the other.
topics.reason: The coordinated answer frame supports an alternative-list reading in which freeing and feeding remain parallel ascent acts.

topics.headline: deed installed before circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first hears the alternative deed itself and only then discovers the scarcity that makes it demanding.
topics.reason: The particle immediately releases into the feeding noun before the temporal-scarcity phrase appears.

words.gloss_range: indefinite Form IV verbal noun naming the deed-category of causing another to eat, with the recipient delayed and the famine-time setting making the act costly
words.root_gloss_range: taste, eating, food, causing to eat, provision, edible share, livelihood, and construction-bound extensions; the local Form IV verbal noun selects outward provisioning
words.prose: {{ar:إِطْعَٰمٌۭ}} ({{tr:iṭʿāmun}}) is an indefinite Form IV verbal noun, so the ayah names feeding as a deed-category before it names agent or recipient. The form turns the root's eating and food field outward: the ascent is causing another to eat, not private eating or a mere food object, and it creates a giver-receiver transfer before either identity is filled in. Its object is withheld until the orphan recipient appears in 90:15, while the present ayah first makes the deed happen in {{ar:مَسْغَبَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:masghabatin}}). That order matters: the reader hears provision before discovering that food is being released under scarcity, with feeding as the first content beat in the chain of deed, day, and famine. The low-occurrence verbal-noun register makes the deed sound like structured ascent-content rather than casual generosity. The accepted perfect-verb variant preserves the same ascent-act while making human agency more explicit, and the echoes with divine feeding from hunger (106:4) and feeding despite attachment to food (76:8) sharpen the human crisis-deed here. Across the boundary from 90:13, the ascent moves from unfastening a constrained body to sustaining a hungry one.

topics.headline: indefinite nominal deed-category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees feeding as a defining ascent-category, not just one narrated incident or a ritual label.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as an indefinite Form IV verbal noun coordinated in the nominal answer phrase.

topics.headline: accepted variant shifts posture to performed feeding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the variant can make the feeder more explicit while preserving the same act inside the steep-path definition.
topics.reason: The local output remains anchored to the canonical nominal surface, while the variant is kept as case and agency evidence rather than allowed to replace the aligned form.

topics.headline: causing another to eat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is about transferred sustenance, so the ascent moves outward toward another body.
topics.reason: The Form IV verbal noun selects causative provision and blocks reducing the word to private eating or a food object.

topics.headline: material food field made outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that the deed is concrete transfer of edible provision rather than abstract kindness.
topics.reason: The broader root field of taste, food, morsel, and livelihood survives as material pressure, while local Form IV grammar keeps outward feeding as the selected sense.

topics.headline: supplier role before needy recipients appear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices transfer before identities: the act creates a giver-receiver relation even while both parties remain unnamed.
topics.reason: Derivative pressure about seeking food is kept as role contrast only; the local surface names giving food, not asking for it.

topics.headline: recipient withheld until the next ayahs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the deed and its scarcity-setting before the vulnerable bodies in 90:15-16 are named.
topics.reason: The local noun is grammatically complete but semantically awaits the recipients named immediately after this ayah.

topics.headline: feeding tested by scarcity-time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that feeding is evaluated by when it happens: it becomes costly provision during hunger-bearing time.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the day phrase the temporal complement of the feeding noun, so timing belongs to the deed's value.

topics.headline: feeding echoes intensified by local famine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare divine feeding from hunger (106:4) and feeding despite love of food (76:8) with this human act inside famine-time.
topics.reason: The referenced parallels are concrete and do not override the local parse; they sharpen the cost of human provision in 90:14.

topics.headline: rare verbal-noun register in structured duty contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the conspicuous deed-form, which makes feeding sound like structured ascent-content rather than casual generosity.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks this exact root-form as low occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows tie that rarity to structured deed language.

topics.headline: act beat, cadence, and embodied sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears feeding as the first content beat in a chain that binds deed, day, and famine.
topics.reason: The sequence places the feeding noun before the setting, and the repeated indefinite endings bind the major nouns audibly.

topics.headline: from bodily liberation to bodily nourishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ascent move from unfastening a constrained body in 90:13 to sustaining a hungry body in 90:14.
topics.reason: The coordinated nominal deeds across 90:13-14 form a concrete rescue pair.

words.gloss_range: preposition of temporal and circumstantial containment governing the day phrase as the setting inside which feeding is evaluated

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed day or crisis interval
the scarcity that defines the day

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) governs {{ar:يَوْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:yawmin}}), making the following day phrase the container in which feeding is evaluated. The particle therefore does more than add a date: because the day is defined by {{ar:مَسْغَبَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:masghabatin}}), temporal placement becomes circumstantial pressure. After the feeding noun, this small preposition pivots the line from deed to setting, so the act is judged inside hunger-time rather than after scarcity has passed.

topics.headline: day governed as temporal container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that feeding is placed inside a pressure-bearing interval, not merely next to a date.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the preposition govern the day as the temporal complement of the feeding noun.

topics.headline: scarcity phrase scopes over the act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole feeding scene narrowed into crisis-feeding, not a generic charitable act.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase modifies the feeding action and adds situational density to the second ascent act.

topics.headline: during a day and within a condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the day both as time and as an enclosing condition of scarcity.
topics.reason: The local governed noun is a day, while the following qualifier makes that time a condition-bearing environment.

topics.headline: short pivot from deed to setting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a compact turn immediately after the deed, as the line moves into its temporal setting without delay.
topics.reason: The preposition begins the second beat and flows directly into the day noun.

words.root_gloss_range: day, daylight span, period, occasion, event-time, and marked evaluative day; local grammar selects an indefinite scarcity-marked interval

words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:yawmin}}) is an indefinite singular day governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), but it is not merely a calendar label. The following {{ar:ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:dhī masghabatin}}) makes it a type of crisis interval, a day characterized by the scarcity it bears. The singular indefinite form concentrates the test into any one such occasion, while the broader day-field lets the word function as event-time. The listener hears feeding in a day before the final word discloses what the day possesses, so time becomes the host and moral instructor of scarcity; the lesson-bearing days of God (14:5) remain an echo, while the local phrase stays a famine-day.

topics.headline: indefinite type of crisis-day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah defines any such hunger-bearing day as the proving interval, not one known date.
topics.reason: The word is indefinite, genitive under the preposition, and immediately qualified by the possessive scarcity phrase.

topics.headline: day characterized through possession phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hunger attached to time through a relation of possession, not collapsed into a bare famine label.
topics.reason: The grammar makes the day the head modified by the five-noun possessive construction and its scarcity complement.

topics.headline: event-time rather than mere daylight span
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the day as the occasion that tests feeding, not as a neutral measure of duration.
topics.reason: The broader day range includes event-time, and local grammar narrows that range to a scarcity-marked temporal circumstance.

topics.headline: evaluative day field localized to famine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels time as morally instructive here, while the local qualifier specifies hunger rather than judgment or divine-days language.
topics.reason: The echo with lesson-bearing days (14:5) survives as contrast, but the local construct phrase selects a hunger-bearing day.

topics.headline: singular interval concentrates the demand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demand can fall within a single crisis interval, without waiting for a broader season.
topics.reason: The local form is singular and indefinite, not plural.

topics.headline: time paired with feeding and possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the day as the syntactic host that binds feeding to the scarcity it possesses.
topics.reason: The local construction pairs the day with the possessive qualifier and places it as the temporal complement of feeding.

topics.headline: day delays the scarcity landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the day as the middle link between deed and crisis, with scarcity arriving as the delayed final disclosure.
topics.reason: The word stands between the feeding noun and final scarcity noun, and the indefinite cadence links the major nouns.

topics.headline: from bare act to occasion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the steep-path definition expand from the act itself to the occasion in which the act becomes weighty.
topics.reason: The day noun adds occasion and moral setting to the already named feeding deed.

words.gloss_range: genitive five-noun possessive adjective meaning possessed of or characterized by, modifying the day and governing the scarcity complement
words.root_gloss_range: possessor, one characterized by a following noun, bearer of an attribute, and related demonstrative or essence-family branches; local five-noun construct selects attributed possession

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the day modified by the possessive adjective

words.prose: {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) is the hinge between day and scarcity. It agrees with {{ar:يَوْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:yawmin}}) and governs {{ar:مَسْغَبَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:masghabatin}}), so hunger is not a loose background noun; it is what the day is characterized by. The possession is descriptive rather than literal ownership, with enough identity pressure to make scarcity cling to the day without turning the word into an independent essence claim. The accepted variant can shift case posture toward a more circumstantial reading but does not detach hunger from the day. This possessive skeleton then prepares the nearness-marked recipient in 90:15 and the recipient description in 90:16. Compared with kinship-recipient possession in 2:177, possession-language is applied first to the day itself before returning to persons.

topics.headline: possessive construct attaches scarcity to the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that scarcity is grammatically made the day's possession, not a detachable background condition.
topics.reason: The five-noun form modifies the day and governs the following scarcity noun as its genitive complement.

topics.headline: possession as characterization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels hunger as the day's defining mark while avoiding a literal ownership reading.
topics.reason: The construct makes the day a bearer of scarcity, but local semantics require attributed characterization rather than property ownership.

topics.headline: identity-like pressure within construct bounds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that scarcity becomes part of how the day is constituted in the phrase, not an incidental side note.
topics.reason: The essence-family pressure is preserved as characterization force, while local grammar keeps the selected function as possessive adjective.

topics.headline: variant shifts case posture but keeps attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the variant may make the phrase more circumstantial while still anchoring hunger to the day.
topics.reason: The canonical output follows the genitive local form; the variant is retained as case contrast because it does not move scarcity away from the day.

topics.headline: possessive skeleton carries into recipient descriptions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one possessive pattern move from crisis-time to the vulnerable recipients of 90:15-16.
topics.reason: The same possessive lexeme appears in the adjacent recipient descriptions, linking condition of time with condition of persons.

topics.headline: possession-language shifts from recipients to time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices charity-style possession language applied first to the day itself before it returns to recipients.
topics.reason: The contrast with kinship possession in 2:177 remains a valid reference, while the local syntax makes time the bearer here.

topics.headline: hinge from time noun to scarcity noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the word as the hinge that turns a bare day into a hunger-bearing day.
topics.reason: The word opens the final qualifier beat and links the preceding day noun to the following scarcity noun.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive mīm state noun naming severe hunger, famine, or scarcity-condition possessed by the day and closing the ayah as the cost of feeding
words.root_gloss_range: hunger, famine, food-scarcity, severe want, and bodily weakening from lack of food; local mīm state noun selects a crisis condition rather than ordinary appetite

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the feeding deed answered by the famine condition

words.prose: {{ar:مَسْغَبَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:masghabatin}}) is the ayah's final landing word. As the genitive complement of {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}), it makes scarcity the defining condition of the day, not a detached background. Its root and mīm state-form point to severe hunger, famine, and bodily weakening, so {{ar:إِطْعَٰمٌۭ}} ({{tr:iṭʿāmun}}) answers danger rather than appetite. The mīm state-form also makes scarcity feel like an environment suffered within, while local grammar keeps that environment attached to the day. The word is indefinite, rare in the supplied evidence, and delayed until the end; the listener first hears feeding and day, then discovers that the deed happens inside deprivation. Its heavier, constricted final sound and indefinite closure make the famine word feel like the chain's tightened landing. The contrast with divine feeding from hunger (106:4) sharpens the local human crisis-deed, and the closure prepares the vulnerable recipients named in 90:15-16, including the concrete poverty named in 90:16. Across 90:13-14, release from bodily constraint gives way to rescue from bodily deprivation.

topics.headline: scarcity possessed by the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees famine defining the temporal setting from inside the syntax.
topics.reason: The word is the genitive complement governed by the construct head, so scarcity is syntactically attached to the day.

topics.headline: indefinite state rather than known famine event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names a kind of scarcity condition that can mark any qualifying day.
topics.reason: The local noun is indefinite genitive and closes the construct as a named condition, not a proper event label.

topics.headline: severe hunger and bodily weakening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands feeding as an answer to bodily danger and deprivation, not preference or ordinary appetite.
topics.reason: The root and local noun select severe hunger, famine, and bodily weakness rather than a mild desire for food.

topics.headline: hunger as inhabitable crisis environment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels scarcity as an environment one suffers within, while the local phrase keeps it attached to a day.
topics.reason: The mīm formation and place-time pressure survive because the word is embedded in a day phrase, but the selected local function remains condition possessed by the day.

topics.headline: feeding answers exactly the famine condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees provision and famine set against each other in one phrase, making the deed costly rather than surplus.
topics.reason: The first content noun names feeding and the final content noun names food-scarcity, creating the local provision-deprivation opposition.

topics.headline: ambient scarcity before named recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition is named before the hungry recipients, so deprivation fills the scene before bodies are specified.
topics.reason: The phrase attributes hunger to the day, and the next ayahs then name the recipient bodies.

topics.headline: personal hunger expands into social crisis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees bodily hunger broaden into a social emergency that prepares concrete poverty in 90:16.
topics.reason: The final noun names a scarcity condition that becomes socially concrete in the following recipient descriptions.

topics.headline: rare famine word bears final load
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah saves a rare, severe scarcity word for its closing pressure.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence marks the exact root-form as low occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows tie that rarity to the final semantic landing.

topics.headline: rarer famine term contrasted with divine feeding formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares divine feeding from hunger (106:4) with this rarer term for a human crisis-deed in 90:14.
topics.reason: The concrete reference (106:4) is retained as contrast without replacing the local word's famine-condition sense.

topics.headline: scarcity delayed to ayah closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first hears feeding and day, then the last word reveals the full cost of that feeding.
topics.reason: The scarcity noun is the final word of the ayah and retroactively qualifies the preceding deed and time.

topics.headline: heavy closure and indefinite cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the line move from open feeding into the heavier, constricted sound of famine.
topics.reason: The final word closes the indefinite noun chain and carries the CRITICAL sound observation about constricted scarcity.

topics.headline: from bodily constraint to bodily deprivation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the steep path as costly intervention in bodily need: release from constraint, then rescue from starvation.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the famine closure with the previous liberation deed and the following beneficiary focus.

topics.headline: hapax rarity, bodily hunger, and sound converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final word as a concentrated crisis-state, not an interchangeable time-label.
topics.reason: The convergence row combines low occurrence, severe hunger semantics, and heavy closure into one locally coherent payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus construction joins the verbal noun إطعام to a severe hunger-event through في يوم ذي مسغبة.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nourishment crosses from a possessor to another person exactly when hunger has become exhausting and socially extensive; timing under scarcity, not food in the abstract, gives the act its force.

activation_trace.role: Giving food to another anchors an outward transfer rather than the feeder's own eating.
The severe event-day makes the transfer a response to an acute occasion.
Hunger with exhaustion and famine supplies the recipient's bodily and collective emergency.

changed_reading.after: Move nourishment outward precisely when famine makes both the need and the cost of giving acute.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إطعام, يوم, and مسغبة can be read as provision sustained across a duration of famine.
baseline_models.mechanism: The provision/livelihood branch and the open-span branch stretch the act beyond one plate: feeding maintains another's viable condition through an interval in which hunger repeatedly returns.

activation_trace.role: Provision and livelihood widen feeding from a meal to material maintenance.
An open span of time lets the hungry period exceed a single daylight interval.
Famine and exhausted hunger make maintenance recurrent rather than episodic.

changed_reading.after: Keep another person provisioned across the duration of an exhausting scarcity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ability branch of ط ع م remains attached to إطعام and meets the exhaustion named by مسغبة.
baseline_models.mechanism: Food intake interrupts hunger's depletion and returns capacity for motion, judgment, and action; the relevant outcome is not merely possession of calories but restored agency.

activation_trace.role: The ability branch supplies restored capability as feeding's functional result.
Taking in nourishment supplies the bodily means by which capability can return.
Hunger joined to exhaustion identifies the incapacity that nourishment reverses.

changed_reading.after: Restore a hunger-exhausted person's power to act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The grafting and receptive-insertion branch belongs to the focus root ط ع م itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: Feeding is imagined as introducing support into a stressed living system so that the support is received and becomes operative, not merely placing an object beside a need.

activation_trace.role: A graft that accepts an insertion supplies the image of aid entering and taking hold.
The severe occasion supplies the stressed environment in which successful uptake matters.
Famine supplies the damaged condition into which sustaining support must take.

changed_reading.after: Introduce sustenance in a form the famine-stressed recipient can actually receive and incorporate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Division into shares, a bounded inhabited place, and an obligation coming due turn famine feeding into reallocation inside a shared civic container: stored livelihood crosses an internal boundary toward the person whose share of survival has failed.

activation_trace.role: Provision and livelihood supply the material that can be redistributed.
Separating a thing into shares supplies the distributive operation.
A bounded place supplies the common spatial container across which provision moves.
An obligation becoming due makes redistribution answerable rather than optional.

structural_cues: 90:1-2 repeats the same البلد around the resident addressee, while 90:14 places feeding inside a second bounded frame, في يوم.
The focus nominalization leaves the distributor unstated, allowing a civic rather than exclusively private agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shares, a bounded place, due obligation, and livelihood; I infer that scarcity makes inhabitants' holdings mutually answerable. A live alternative is that oath and city frame only intensify rhetoric without specifying redistribution.

changed_reading.before: A private donor gives food during famine.
changed_reading.after: A bounded community's provision is reapportioned when a member's survival-share collapses.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generation produces vulnerable life into hardship, while the focus branch of continuous formation makes feeding the maintenance bridge by which created life continues after its initial coming-to-be.

activation_trace.role: Continuous formation makes nourishment part of keeping a living form ongoing.
Famine supplies the interruption that threatens life's continuation.
Something generated from another supplies intergenerational dependence and succession.
Bringing creation into being supplies the life whose continuation requires maintenance.
Hardship and struggle supply the resistant condition through which life must be carried.

structural_cues: Parent and offspring in 90:3 are followed by human creation in hardship in 90:4, before the focus later names nourishment under hunger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generation, creation, continuous formation, and hardship; I infer a causal bridge in which feeding maintains what generation begins. The alternative is that the creation sequence states a general human condition without a maintenance claim.

changed_reading.after: Carry generated human life forward through the hardship that threatens its continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence opposes a speaker's counted claim of exhausting piled wealth to capacity and visibility. The focus supplies a bodily audit: expenditure counts as feeding when an exhausted other visibly regains ability, not when the spender merely names a large amount.

activation_trace.role: Ability supplies the recipient-side outcome by which expenditure can be tested.
Exhausted hunger supplies the deficit whose reversal would be bodily evidence.
Counting and accounting supply the evaluative ledger.

strongest_changes: Feeding became the recipient's embodied audit of claimed expenditure: restored capacity matters more than the donor's announced amount.

summary.what_was_special: The focus supported several simultaneous scales: acute transfer, duration-long maintenance, restoration of agency, receptive grafting, civic redistribution, network repair, and communal formation. Split mappings added contained but productive surprises around quenching, apparent smallness, stored wealth, and ecological maturation.
remaining_uncertainties: يوم can remain an acute severe occasion or widen into a longer famine-span; neither temporal scale eliminates the other.
The civic-share, recipient-outcome audit, and sealed-store models require reader-supplied directional arrows even though every component is packet-backed.
The throat-release, split-root, and ecological readings are mechanistically coherent but should remain explicitly exploratory rather than become lexical paraphrases.
The sequence after ثم may make community a consequence of the acts, an added qualification on their agent, or both.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Feeding as intervention in an event-day.** Lexical evidence: ط ع م B002 “feeding and asking for food,” B004 “provision/livelihood,” ي و م B003 “event-day or severe occasion,” س غ ب B001 “hunger with exhaustion and famine.” Structural cue: the act follows freeing a neck and is specified by “في يوم ذي مسغبة.” Assigned role: feeding supplies provision precisely when the day itself is a famine-event. Abductive move: I infer that the timing is part of the act’s meaning: ordinary food becomes pass-crossing when placed inside crisis. 2. **Mouth and throat redirected from boast to sustenance.** Lexical evidence: ط ع م B001 “taste/eating,” B012 “gripping the throat in choking,” with 90:9 ل س ن B001 tongue and ش ف ه B001 lips. Structural cue: the mouth-parts precede, and the hungry recipient follows. Assigned role: feeding turns the mouth from speech/self-report into the channel for another’s survival. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi duyusal tatmayı, bir şeyi yemeyi ve yenilen besini aynı çekirdekte toplar; içecek de tadına bakılan veya besleyen bir şey olduğunda bu alana girer. Bu çerçeve, buğdaya özgü kullanımı ve doyurucu yiyecek ya da su kalıbını çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleri olarak tutmayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın tatma, yeme ve besin anlamlarını kapsar; buğdaya özgü adlandırma ile doyurup besleyen yiyecek ya da su kullanımı ayrıca sınırlandırılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin tadını duyuyla algılamak veya onu yemek; ayrıca yenilen ve açlığı gideren besin. İçecek, tadına bakılması ya da besleyici olması bakımından bu kapsama girebilir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin tadını duyuyla algılama ve ondan tat alma.
Bir şeyi yeme veya besin olarak tüketme.
Yenilen, açlığı gideren ve kimi bağlamlarda içeceği de kapsayan besin.
Bazı kullanımlarda besin adının özellikle buğdaya ayrılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi tat duyusu, yeme eylemi ve yenilen besindir; içecek ise tadılan veya besleyen şey olarak bu çizgiye bağlanır. Bazı kullanımlarda genel besin adı özellikle buğdayı gösterebilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca meyve veya hurma ağacının olgunlaşıp tat kazanması kalıbına bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Meyvenin, özellikle hurma ağacının ürünü olgunlaşarak yenilebilir ve belirgin bir tat kazanmış duruma gelmesi.

facets.statement: Meyvenin olgunlaşıp yenilebilir ve belirgin bir tat kazanması.
Hurma ağacı veya hurma meyvesi olgunlaştığında tadı belirginleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği meyvenin, özellikle hurma meyvesinin, olgunlaşıp tat kazanmasıdır.

concept_gloss.text: olgunlaşıp tat kazanmak

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hurma ağacı veya başka bir meyvenin yenilecek olgunluğa eriştiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Meyvenin olgunlaşıp tat kazanma sürecini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tulumdaki sütün hoş tat kazanması kullanımını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal meyvenin olgunlaşmasını özellikle yenilebilir tat kazanması bakımından kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal meyve ve ağacın olgunlaşmasını tat vurgusu olmadan daha genel biçimde anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal meyvenin olgunluğa erişmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Meyve bağlamında büyük ölçüde örtüşürler; buradaki dalın ayırıcı yanı olgunluğun tat kazanma olarak kavranmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar karşılaştırıldı; genel meyve olgunlaşması komşusu, bu dalın tat kazanma koşulunu en açık biçimde sınırlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca bir av aracını değil, avı sahibine kazandıran yayı, avcı kuşun öndeki kalın parmağını ve avdan yana talihli kişiyi birlikte verir. identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel insan besleme anlamı ile hayvanın semizliği bu av alanına dahil değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yay ve av başarısı kalıplarını ayrı tutarken avcı kuşun parmak adını yalın, bedensel bir alt anlam olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Avı yakalayıp sahibine kazandıran yay veya avcı kuş uzvu; ayrıca avda sıkça başarılı olup avdan pay alan kişi.

facets.statement: Avı ele geçirerek avcıya yiyecek veya kazanç sağlayan araç olma.
Avcı kuşun avı kavramaya yarayan öndeki kalın parmağı.
Avda sıkça başarı gösteren ve avdan yana payı açık kişi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yayı, kuşun öndeki avcı parmağını ve avda başarılı kişiyi avın sahibine kazandırılması bağıyla birleştirir. Bunlar sırasıyla araç, beden bölümü ve kişi niteliğidir.

concept_gloss.text: avı kazandıran araç, uzuv veya kişi

error_profile.preserves: Araç, kuş uzvu ve başarılı avcı ayrımlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Avı vurarak sahibine yiyecek veya kazanç sağlayan yayın nitelenmesinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yayın avı sahibine kazandırma işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kuş parmağını ve avda talihli kişi anlamını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal avın ele geçirilmesi ve av araçları alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Buradaki dar nitelemeler avı sahibine kazandırma sonucuna bağlıdır; komşu ise avlanma etkinliğinin ve nesnelerinin genel söz varlığıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel avlanma dalı, buradaki işlevsel araç ve başarı nitelemelerinin dar kapsamını en iyi ortaya koyar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القوس المطعمة والجوارح أو الإصبع المطعمة وما يطعم صاحبه الصيد أو يكون مرزوقا منه

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hayvanın iliğinde yağ tadı bulunmasını ve koyun, deve ya da kesimlik hayvanın bir miktar semiz veya zayıfla semiz arasında olmasını bildirir. Duyusal tat burada bağımsız amaç değil, beden yağının saptanma belirtisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel tat alma veya her türlü beden yağı değil, hayvanın belirli derecedeki semizliği ve ilikteki yağ belirtisiyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hayvanın ilik ve beden yağından anlaşılan semizlik derecesini yalın dal anlamı olarak verir; başka alanlardaki özel kalıpları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir hayvanın iliğinde yağ tadı bulunacak kadar semiz olması veya zayıf ile tam semiz arasında bir miktar yağ tutmuş bulunması.

facets.statement: Hayvanın iliğinde yağ tadı ve belirtisi bulunması.
Hayvanın biraz semiz veya zayıfla semiz arasında olması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hayvandaki semizliği, ilikte algılanan yağ belirtisi ve zayıflıkla tam semizlik arasındaki beden durumu üzerinden tanımlar.

concept_gloss.text: ilikte yağı beliren, biraz semiz hayvan

error_profile.preserves: İlikteki yağ belirtisi ile kısmi semizlik derecesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Koyun veya devenin zayıfla tam semiz arasında bulunduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın kısmi semizlik derecesini korur.
error_profile.loses: İlikte yağ tadı bulunması ölçütünü açıkça göstermez.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insanı veya hayvanı kapsayan genel yağlılık ve bedenin yağla dolması anlamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kısmi hayvan semizliği ve genel yağlılık
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bedende yağ bulunması ve semizlik alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Buradaki anlam hayvanla ve belirli bir semizlik derecesiyle sınırlıdır; komşu ise bedenin genel yağlanmasını daha geniş katılımcı kapsamıyla anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yağlılık komşusu, bu dalın hayvana ve ilik belirtisine bağlı dar sınırını en iyi açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi olumlu olarak akıl ve sağlam yargıyı, olumsuz kalıplarda ise akılsızlık, devinimsizlik, değersizlik, eğitilemezlik veya cılızlığı bildirir. Dalın 'akıl ve değer' çerçevesi kullanılabilir, ancak olumsuz biçimlerin her zaman yalnızca akıl yokluğu demediği açıkça korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal duyusal lezzeti veya yiyeceği değil, belirli kişi niteleme kalıplarında akıl, değer ve düzelmeye açıklık değerlendirmesini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca akıllı olma, akıl ya da değer yokluğu ve terbiyeden yararlanmama bildiren kişi niteleme kalıplarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kişi nitelemelerinde akıl, sağlam yargı veya dikkate değer bir nitelik taşıma; olumsuz biçimlerde bunlardan yoksun, cılız, devinimsiz ya da düzeltilemez olma.

facets.statement: Akıl, sağlam yargı ve ölçülü karar gücü taşıma.
Olumsuz kalıpta akıl, devinim, değer veya dolgunluktan yoksun olma.
Öğüt, eğitim veya düzeltmeden yararlanmayıp uslanmama.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kişi hakkında olumlu bir akıl ve yargı niteliği ile bunun olumsuzlanmasını verir; olumsuzlama bağlama göre akılsızlık, devinimsizlik, değersizlik, cılızlık veya eğitilemezlik biçiminde açılır.

concept_gloss.text: akıl, değer ve düzelmeye açıklık niteliği
concept_gloss.applicability: Olumlu ve olumsuz kişi niteleme kalıplarındaki değerlendirme eksenini birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Akıl, değer, devinim ve düzelmeye açıklık değerlendirmelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin akıllı ve sağlam yargılı olduğunun olumlu biçimde belirtildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Akıl ve sağlam yargı niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Olumsuz değer, devinim ve eğitilemezlik kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişinin akıllı ve ölçülü oluşunu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme akıl niteliğindedir; burada anlam olumlu ve olumsuz kişi değerlendirmelerine yayılırken komşuda aklın davranışı dizginleyen işlevi belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; engelleyici akıl komşusu ortak çekirdeği gösterirken bu dalın değer ve eğitilebilirlik uzantılarını ayırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi atın burun altından dudak uçlarına uzanan ağız bölümünü ve attan koşmasını isteme eylemini ayrı fakat aynı at alanında verir. Dalın kimliği bu iki alt alanı kaynaştırmadan birlikte koruduğunda kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ağız bölümü ile koşma talebi ayrı tutulur; yiyecek, kuş ayağı veya atın fiilen koşması bu dalın doğrudan anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Atın ağız bölümü yalın adlandırma, koşmasını isteme ise yalnızca belirtilen kalıp olarak tanımlanır; ikisi tek bir eylem anlamında birleştirilmez.

facets.statement: Atın burun altı ile dudak uçları arasındaki ağız bölümü.
Attan hızlanmasını veya koşmasını isteme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar atın ağız ve dudak çevresindeki belirli bölgesini adlandırır; ayrıca ayrı bir söz kalıbında binicinin attan koşmasını istemesini bildirir.

concept_gloss.text: atın ağız bölümü ve koşma talebi

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği açlık ve acıkmadır. Yorgunluk bütün kaynaklarda zorunlu bir koşul değildir; bazı kaynaklar anlamı yorgunlukla birlikte yaşanan açlıkla sınırlar. Kıtlık ise aynı anlam alanındaki türemiş adın belirginleşmiş kullanımını oluşturur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yalın açlığı da kapsar; yorgunluğu her kullanım için zorunlu saymaz ve kıtlık anlamını türemiş adın uzmanlaşmış kullanımında tutar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak kökün açlık ve acıkma çekirdeğini esas alır; yorgunluk kısıtını kaynak değişkesi, kıtlığı ise türemiş bir uzmanlaşma olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin aç olması ya da acıkmasıdır; bazı kaynaklarda bu açlığın yorgunlukla birlikte bulunması özellikle belirtilir. Aynı kökten türeyen bir ad, şiddetli ve yaygın açlık olan kıtlığı da anlatır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, yiyecek gereksinimi duyan kişinin aç olması veya acıkmasıdır.
Bazı kaynaklar açlığı, kişiyi yoran veya bitkin bırakan açlıkla sınırlar.
Türemiş bir ad, şiddetli ve yaygın açlık durumunu, yani kıtlığı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar açlık ve acıkma çekirdeğinde birleşir; aç kişiyi bildiren biçimleri ve açlık bildiren adları da bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Bununla birlikte bazı tanımlar açlığı genel bırakırken bazıları yorgunluğu ayırt edici bir koşul sayar; türemiş ad ise kıtlık ve şiddetli açlık anlamını taşır. Jamhara kaynağa özgü ek mastar biçimini, Sihah ise kaynağa özgü dişil sıfat biçimini ayrıca kaydeder.
